events.body:
## Summary

Design the future application flow without accidentally exposing sensitive applicant data in public Git.

The preferred initial model is conservative: external apply URLs, email/contact preferences, and public seeker profiles. Git-native application artifacts can be explored only with explicit public-data boundaries.

## Scope

- Minimal identity: Git username + email/contact preference.
- Public seeker profile privacy rules.
- Contact preference design.
- Future `applications/<job-id>/<username>.md` model decision.
- Application issue/MR flow risk assessment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document what seeker data is public and what should not be collected.
- [ ] Update profile template copy to warn that profiles are public Git data.
- [ ] Prefer contact preferences/Git profiles over public email by default.
- [ ] Define application options: external URL, email, issue-based, MR/PR-based, or deferred backend.
- [ ] If a Git-native application file is proposed, define the minimal safe public fields.
- [ ] Do not implement public application storage until the privacy decision is explicit.
